about: MUTATING — mirror the CI build's external base images (the kaniko executor from gcr.io, plus the boss-ci Dockerfile's oven/bun and rust bases from docker.io) into the forge registry, so build-image resolves NO public DNS. Runs infra/forge/mirror-base-images.sh, which pulls a FIXED in-tree list and pushes it to 10.20.0.15:3000/david — bounded by construction like reclaim-disk (no packet-supplied image name). The gcr.io/docker.io DNS flake reddened trains #236 and #250; this moves that lookup off the every-train hot path onto an occasional, retryable job. Idempotent (re-mirrors the same tags). THE READ-BACK (backlog 1058e686, car E): after each push the script checks the forge tag is locally the pulled image, takes the digest that pulled image records for the forge repository (RepoDigests, written by the push), and requires the registry to hold a manifest at that digest AND its tag to serve that same manifest (`docker manifest inspect --insecure`, twice); a different manifest is FAILED and no answer is CANNOT ANSWER, and NEITHER stops the loop — every image is still pushed and read back (under the containerd image store the pulled index digest may never resolve, and a mirror that stopped at image 1 would strand the base it exists to repair); the run then exits 1 naming each image that did not read back, so `done`, the declared effect, prints only when every pushed tag read back. The `--missing` presence check also passes `--insecure`, because the forge registry is plain HTTP and the CLI otherwise reads every tag as absent. Its own timeout: ten images, each allowed four pulls with 10+15+20 s of backoff before a byte moves (450 s of sleep in the worst case), then the transfer of every layer (the rust and cloud-sdk bases alone are hundreds of megabytes) and three registry reads per image — the runner's 30 s default would kill it at the first large pull; 1800 s is four times the backoff floor. Authorized by David 2026-09-07, same explicit per-verb process as reclaim-disk / rollback-to / converge. Backlog 7f408b99.
effect: ^mirror-base-images: done — [0-9]+ image[(]s[)] mirrored to .+, each read back from the registry at the digest its pulled source records
